Name: Thirsting Claws
Description: You perform a swiping notion with your hand, gigantic blood-soaked claws forming in the air to rake at a target. You perform a Ranged Spell Attack against a target within reach, dealing 1d4 slashing damage and inflicting 2 Bleed on a hit.
At Higher Levels: This spell’s damage increases by 1d4 and inflicts 2 more Bleed when you reach 5th level (2d4 and 4), 11th level (3d4 and 6), and 17th level (4d4 and 8).
